# Archon OS

> Archon OS is a self-hosted, MIT-licensed multi-agent business operating system built on Hermes Agent. It provides enterprise-grade governance, pre-execution token budget control, fail-closed Zero-Egress local LLM routing, WebAuthn Passkey human-in-the-loop approvals, and a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log on your own Docker server.

- Website: https://michaelbeatman.github.io/ARCHON-OS/
- Source Code (MIT License): https://github.com/michaelbeatman/ARCHON-OS
- Author: Michael Keller
- Current Release: v0.5.7 (pre-1.0, Docker amd64 / arm64)

## Core Architecture & Differentiators

- **70 Specialist Agent Profiles across 8 Domains:** Strategy & Leadership, Law/Tax/Finance, Sales/CRM/Marketing, Creation/Media, Tech/Software/QA, Commerce/Procurement, Real Estate/Construction, and Medicine/Chemistry/Engineering, structured in 3 competency tiers with four-eyes verification.
- **PolicyEngine & Signed Tool Warrants:** Default-deny tool access. Privileged tools (`pay`, external `mcp__*`) require HMAC-SHA256 signed, time-limited warrants with parameter bounds (`max_amount`, `allowed_path_prefixes`). Delegated sub-agents never inherit privileged tools.
- **Atomic BudgetBank:** Pre-execution transactional budget reservations (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`) prevent parallel agents from exceeding cost caps.
- **Passkey / WebAuthn HITL:** High-risk approvals (payments, budget overruns, project starts, destructive actions) require cryptographic verification via device passkeys (Windows Hello, Touch ID, Face ID, hardware keys).
- **Fail-Closed Zero-Egress Routing:** Central switchboard (OmniRoute) routes sensitive categories (finance, contracts, CRM, HR, GDPR) exclusively to local models (Ollama, LM Studio) inside an internal Docker network with no internet route.
- **Crash-Safe Execution (Effect-Ledger):** Transactional Effect-Ledger (`PENDING -> COMMITTED / FAILED / UNKNOWN`) with mandatory reconciliation and Outbox idempotency keys prevents duplicate side effects.
- **Auditability & Compliance:** SHA-256 hash-chained audit log, consolidated 3-database SQLite WAL architecture (`ops.db`, `business.db`, `memory.db`), Litestream replication, EU AI Act risk registry, and 1-click GoBD procedural documentation export.
- **AI Boardroom & Knowledge Base:** 55 structured multi-perspective decision frameworks, local Obsidian Markdown vault + AnythingLLM/Chroma RAG, and embedded n8n webhook automation.

## Quick Start

- Full stack: `git clone https://github.com/michaelbeatman/ARCHON-OS.git && cd ARCHON-OS && docker compose up -d`
- Zero-key demo mode: `ARCHON_DEMO_MODE=true docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up --build -d`
